scope: All exported RS422 electrical/device/topology/termination/codec/timing parameters reviewed individually for meaning,type,unit,bounds,dependencies and source. No normative minimum operating bitrate exists in selected reference; no fabricated10Mbps default.

One driver per pair; standard up10 receivers, point-to-point exactlyone. Duplex two independently qualified pairs, distinct multipoint RS485. TIA2010reference bitrate<=10Mbps versus separately source/device-qualified higher rates with both capabilities.

Driver loaded100ohm differential2..10V/offset3V/imbalance.4V; shorttoground150mA; poweroff100uA under-.25..6V. Receiver4kohm,commonmode-7..7V,differential200mV..10V with actual truth table and signedA-B. Undefinednear0/failsafe doesnotprove decoded valid data.

100ohm fixture is conditional test proposal, not installed termination. Single farreceiver termination within20percent of actual lineimpedance; ACcapacitor needs actualqualification,1000pF example notdefault. Unterminated shortline lowrate<=200k or rise>4 actual one-waydelay need actual source.

Waveform at100ohm monotonic10-90percent<=max20ns,.1UI and overshoot<=10percent. Cable length/stubs/grounding require actualproject evidence;1200m not universal maximum. Higher-layer framing/blockcode independent, explicit word/wirebits/rate/time/processing/fulltransaction/freshness.

Actual value acceptance requires validated electrical/truthtable/termination/codec/observedwave/clock/normalactive state and separate completechain. Conditional settings validation remains independent from capacity/runtime certification, MODEL_MISSING.
781 isolated tests PASS, 164 native andnine shared suites.
